Rieri Bishop is a Space Federation Army Commander and senior investigator belonging to the army military police investigation department and the arch enemy of Donny Bohgan.

Rieri is one of the two heroines of Prison Battleship.

I am Rieri Bishop. Commander of the Space Federation army. Where is this place? The Earth of the past? Or an alternate world? This looks like a pain.
Rieri Bishop

Personality
In Prison Battleship, a veteran officer who has a lovely, calm, cool, and collected judgment, but she is very arrogant due to all her achievements and she will abuse her authority to get what she wants.

In addition, she is very confident, since she knew that the battleship that transported her to Earth to be able to report the crimes of the Neo Terras was compromised, but decides to board the Jasant with Naomi, thinking that she can threaten and intimidate the crew. So that they are subjected during the 7-day trip. Although, Rieri planned to have ambushed the ship just before it reached Earth.

After the destruction of her old personality, she remains mostly the same, but is 100% loyal to Donny Bohgan. She is not able to control her lust for him well and will ask for sex frequently. She is a good former friend of Alicia Viewstroem, and Alicia was on her wedding with Yu Amada. Even after her brainwashing, would have some minor traces of affection for her old husband and feelings of guilt, which would fade quickly into a cold indifference.

Appearance
She has teal-colored eyes and violet hair. Rieri also had a voluptuous figure.

History
Background
A member of the Space Federation aligned with the New Solar faction.

She was born on Saturn's terraformed moon Titan. Her father is the high ranking Admiral George Bishop. In the past the Neo Terra would try to kidnap her father but she and her loyal friend and junior Naomi Evans stopped it. Killing most of the attackers but leaving Donny Bohgan alive, which was working undercover. Unaware of his relevance, he only was imprisoned under suspicions.

Rieri got married around year 2248 to Yu Amada and became famous among the New Solars, treated like a celebrity. Based on her wishes, Yu and Rieri would take a small home on titan, which was designed after European homes of the past. Naomi, became friends with Alicia Viewstroem at some point, of the royalty of Principality of Cordelia even though, the group preferred to stay out of the fighting between New Solar and Neo Terra.

Visual Novels
She and Naomi tried to investigate the Battleship Jasant, in the year 2251, by pretending to take down Neo Terra criminals on earth but fell into Bohgan's trap instead. On the 7-day trip, she was knocked out with sleeping gas and put into a Brainwashing Machine, her body was modified to cum easy. However, she would not remember at day, only becoming slaves to Bohgan in the night, which continued their brainwashing, with her old and new personality being switched. At first, it appeared that Rieri and Naomi, freed themselves last minute, and were able to capture Bohan as they arrived at the station. However, the brainwashing effect which was almost complete lingered and Rieri and Naomi confronted Bogan in his holding cell, which completed the brainwashing. Afterward, they would free him.

After her training was finished and her old personality was deleted, she became loyal Bohgan. Divorced her husband after three years and joined Donny also to enslave Maya Cordelia in Cordelia, assisting her during that time. She, furthermore, appeared in Prison Battleship 3, in which Naomi Evans had broken free from the brainwashing and attempted to kill Donny or force him to free Rieri as well. However, unlike Naomi, the personality of Rieri seems to be gone for good, at least for now, and in a display of loyalty, was ready to kill herself on the spot, if Noami would continue her pursuit against Donny. Afterward, Naomi relented and assisted Donny, during the events on Mars, in the hope that she could later on find some way to cure Rieri.

Timeline TABA
Transported by a spacetime anomaly to the past, she is captured by a criminal group. Which tries to gather information.

Timeline RPGX
Not mentioned but since the Prison Universe visited by Fuuma Kotaro, contains Donny Bohgan already disguised as Cordelia, she is probably captured.

Additional Material
Unlike in the game, where she reveal that she remembers Bohgan's voice, which is why she is so eager to investigates the ship, in the OVA, she and Naomi both already forgotten him completely. As Bohgan is much more driven by revenge, he takes this personally. The OVA also follows the Good Ending and not the True Ending.
Powers/Abilities
Main Weapon: Gun

Trained soldier
Slave/Toy: She and Naomi were modified to be perfect slave/toys.
